g.text: IN (food/drink) = OUT (BMR ~60–70% + activity + digestion) → stable · IN > OUT → gain ·
IN < OUT → lose. Needs rise: pregnancy (+340–450), lactation (+500), teens, illness, manual
work; fall: elders, sedentary, small frames. Counsel portions + movement, never starvation.
FIBRE 25–30 g/day: feeds gut, slows sugar, lowers cholesterol, fills cheaply —
beans, vegetables, fruits, whole grains, groundnut skins. Add GRADUALLY + water (gas fades).
WATER: 1.5–2 L/day (more in heat, fever, breastfeeding, diarrhoea; LESS where restricted —
heart/kidney limits honoured!). Pale urine = hydrated. Sugary drinks ≠ water (liquid weight).
GLYCAEMIC SENSE: pair carbs with protein/fibre/fat (banku + beans + veg beats banku alone);
whole fruit > juice (fibre kept, sugar slowed); breakfast eaten (skippers overeat nights).
GHANA PLATE WISDOM: fufu/banku/kenkey + soup with fish/beans + plenty veg = ALREADY
balanced — counsel PORTIONS (fist carbs, palm protein, 2 fists veg) + oil restrained + salt-
smart, not foreign foods. Festive overload + daily soft drinks = the modern mismatch.
COUNSELLING: 24-h recall ("what did you eat yesterday?") → praise good → ONE change ("swap
afternoon Coke for water + groundnuts") → teach-back → review. Shame starves honesty;
poverty-aware plans (beans/eggs/groundnut = cheap protein; seasonal veg = cheap vitamins).
Nurses model: eat breakfast, drink water on shift, fruit in bag — counselled plates start
with the counsellor's own. Document diet counsel given (PRO-I M5).
Exam line: \"4-4-9, fibre 25+, water pale — portions counselled, poverty respected.\"
